evals.name: apply-vercel-landing-page
evals.prompt: Build a landing page for a serverless database startup called 'NeonEdge' in the style of Vercel. The page needs: a hero with tagline and CTA, a three-feature grid, a code snippet demo block, a 'trusted by' logo strip, and a footer. Use React and Tailwind. Dark theme. Here's the Vercel DESIGN.md path: /home/mihai/code/skills/design-md-catalog/vercel/DESIGN.md

assertions.text: Produces React component code with Tailwind classes, not just a description
States the selected style slug and source DESIGN.md file path in the response
Translates source aesthetic into product-specific content — does not copy Vercel brand marks, logos, or product names
Code covers all requested sections: hero, feature grid, code snippet, logo strip, footer
Does not mix in another famous brand's visual DNA unless explicitly stated as intentional
Response summarizes main implementation changes applied

evals.name: apply-linear-project-dashboard
evals.prompt: Build a project management dashboard shell in the style of Linear. It needs: a sidebar with project list, a main content area with an issue table (columns: title, status, assignee, priority), a top command palette bar, and keyboard shortcut hints. Use React and Tailwind. Dark theme. The DESIGN.md file is at /home/mihai/code/skills/design-md-catalog/linear/DESIGN.md

assertions.text: Produces React component code with Tailwind classes, not just a description
Includes a command palette bar component reflecting Linear's keyboard-first DNA
Layout has a sidebar + main content area split
Translation covers color tokens, typography, spacing density, and component geometry from the source
Does not copy Linear brand name, product names, or exact marketing copy
States the source file and summarizes main implementation changes
